product.olivetti-p700.summary: The P700 brought MiTAC’s Micro Channel platform to Olivetti.
product.olivetti-p700.history: Olivetti sold the P700 on the MiTAC MPS3000F platform. The same board is also documented in the Memorex Telex 7270.
product.olivetti-p700.architecture: The board can be identified by its Micro Channel codes. Ardent Tool records ID FEFF and the F8/0D pair for the P700-100.
product.olivetti-p700.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-p700.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-p700.ardent-planar: Ardent Tool, Mitac MPS3000F, Memorex Telex 7270 and Olivetti P700
product.olivetti-p700.pc-magazine: PC Magazine, Cashing In on the Micro Channel, 30 October 1990
